# Shadowkin
These are highly intellectual beings of unknown origin, possessing a quite unique physiology unlike previously seen. Their natural tongue is Marish. Regarding their anatomy, they possess large ears, [color=#1e90ff]very sensitive eyes[/color], and a tail for balance. It is also worth noting that their blood has a much higher concentration of iron in it when compared to other species.
## Background
Your kin were used to swimming through the Noosphere; taking a small, almost microscopic form that was resilient to the sphere’s harsh conditions.
When the turbulence in the Noosphere grew too much to handle, you entered a stasis called “rama,” successfully preserving yourself in the realm of thought and dreams. Despite your distance to one another, you communicated through a language not even scientists could recreate: echoes of the mind that vibrated through your bodies.
It was every kin’s destiny to swim to what was called ‘the Dark’ to begin their adulthood…the darkest reaches of the Noosphere. But the Dark has been changing, becoming a turbulent realm where many struggled to survive.
So your kin migrated, taking the form born from the many thoughts you were created from. Many were just as curious about you as you were about them. Corporations hired you to learn about your innate connection to the Noosphere… and how they could use you to their advantage. Now, your kin struggle to fit into a new society that has been imposed upon you.
Some return to the Dark, while others embrace the change and form themselves through new connections and experiences.
## Unique Abilities
### Empathy
- They have been observed to [color=#1e90ff]sustain a telepathic link[/color] with other Shadowkin, being able to communicate through a hivemind.
## Benefits
- They have the ability to survive in space for surprisingly longer than expected, taking [color=#1e90ff]50% less pressure damage[/color]. - Their iron-concentrated blood significantly reduces their oxygen consumption and allows them to survive without it for much more prolonged periods of time. - They appear to have a certain affinity to darkness, being rumored to be able to [color=#1e90ff]see in complete darkness[/color], unlike other species. - Their [color=#1e90ff]speed is slightly faster than humans[/color] due to their decreased bone density and superior agility. - Their unarmed attacks deal [color=#ec3a3a]5 Slash[/color].
## Drawbacks
- They prefer lower temperature environments compared to humans, making them more susceptible to higher temperatures. - Their smaller stature makes them take [color=#ffa500]25% more brute damage.[/color] - They take [color=#ffa500]50% more heat damage[/color] - Due to their sensitive eyes, flashes have a stronger effect on them. - Their decreased bone density makes it harder to drag objects and people.
